title: Form 1099-INT box 4 statement items, tax year 2025
closure_claim: Every federal income tax withheld amount reported in box 4 of a Form 1099-INT furnished to the taxpayer for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item as of the keyed horizon. This claim covers Form 1099-INT box 4 only: it says nothing about boxes 1, 3, 8, or 10. Closed with members authorizes the sum of current members; closed-empty authorizes subtotal 0.
